findings.description: The bucket has no ACL set (defaults may allow public access) and is explicitly commented as public with no bucket policy or public access block restricting access, exposing potentially sensitive data (customer-master.xlsx) to unauthenticated users.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket (including sensitive customer data) are not encrypted at rest.
A customer master data file is uploaded to a bucket that is publicly accessible and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer information to potential attackers.
The bucket stores financial data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving operational data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving data science datasets unencrypted at rest.
